title: Milestone 3 — the second read is admitted at 0.7, then succeeds at 1.1
subtitle: Policy: attempts=5, retry_on=[ReportNotReady], initial_delay=max_delay=0.3, time_budget=1.0. The clock and waiting provider are external dependencies in the same process.

actors.title: Report viewer
body: Proposed: also sets budget=1.0; keeps a late successful report.

actors.title: Budget
body: Proposed: own the invocation’s baseline and strict admission checks using the supplied clock.

actors.title: retry executor
body: Proposed: consult Budget before waiting and before retrying; return success directly.

actors.title: load_report
body: Owns its execution. In this acceptance case, each read consumes 0.4 seconds; read 1 fails and read 2 succeeds.

actors.title: wait(seconds)
body: Receives 0.3 and advances the controlled clock by that amount. Production waiting may overshoot.

actors.title: clock()
body: Controlled acceptance readings: 0.0, 0.4, 0.7. Time advances to 1.1 during read 2.

events: sample clock immediately before first call
read 1 — initial call is always permitted
returns the report unchanged; no post-success budget veto
notes: Alternative: read 2 raises at 1.1. The full next wait cannot fit; re-raise failure #2 with no second wait.
Oversleep: if the post-wait reading is >= 1.0, preserve failure #1 and never invoke read 2.
The clock defines observed admission time. There is no interruption of a running call or hard real-time start guarantee.
